newsitem.title: CENTRAL AFRICAN REPUBLIC: New army chief named in Central African Republic.
newsitem.headline: New army chief named in Central African Republic.

text.p: Central African Republic's president, Ange-Felix Patasse, named a new armed forces chief of staff on Wednesday, promoting armed forces inspector-general General Francois Bozize to the job.
The appointment of Bozize, from the north like Patasse, was announced in a presidential decree read on state television. He replaces Colonel Maurice Regonessa.

Patasse, his grip on power shaken by three army mutinies in under a year, announced the formation of a national unity government on Tuesday, under an African mediated deal to end a cycle of political, military and ethnic violence.
Mutinies in April and May began over pay and conditions but turned into a campaign to oust Patasse.
French troops, in the country under a defence pact, stepped in to restore order. African peacekeepers have since started to patrol in their place.
